style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, a heavy realistic serpent, horror jump scare, hard noon sun
motion_rule: he never stops: a sidewinding sprint from the first frame, his body swinging wide across the frame, the camera racing backwards so a whole billboard sweeps out of frame every half second and his face stays to the lens; four times he throws himself into the lens with jaws wide; his head fills half the frame height, head-on and closer from 8.2; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a huge heavy python, glossy black-green scales with brown diamond blotches, a broad wedge head, pale amber slit eyes, long curved fangs, a scuffed grey collector waistcoat, deadpan
second_characters: ONE white mouse bolting across the road, first beat only; ONE grey rat in a red visor sprinting at the lens, flinging bills
props: overdue bill sheets the rat flings, each with a big red stamp; a paper maw of folded bills, crease teeth, running low on the tarmac
prop_continuity: the red stamp stays readable; the maw arrives already folded and is never built on screen; it runs on the tarmac beside him, never worn on his head; speech is only heard, never shown

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a cold sibilant male voice, a dry snake hiss riding every word, s and sh drawn out into a hiss without adding syllables, deadpan, even 4.0 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.0-1.5 one breath; pause 1.5-2.8; 2.8-4.4 one breath; pause 4.4-5.4; 5.4-9.0 one breath; after 9.0 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a long low hiss under every line, scales hissing over tarmac all clip, paper storm, a heavy thud on each lunge, a wet gulp at 1.4, a paper clap at 7.0

environment: a sunlit motorway, red stamped loan billboards flashing past both sides

timeline.a: he sidewinds hard across the frame, coils pumping, the white mouse bolting across the tarmac just ahead of his snout
he scoops the mouse up in his jaws at full drive, gone in one gulp, a lump running down his neck
he throws himself into the lens, jaws wide, fangs first, then drops back still driving hard
he bursts head first through a billboard into the lens, boards blowing apart
his tail whips a billboard pole into a blizzard of bills streaking backwards past him
head on to the lens, driving hard, billboards ripping past both edges, bills wiping the lens
he strikes at the lens, fangs first, filling the frame, then whips back
the paper maw drops onto the tarmac and snaps twice at the rat heels while the rat sprints at the lens
he drives head on at the lens, road markings tearing past under him, the maw hurtling along the tarmac behind him
the maw catches the rat from behind at a full run and claps shut over him in one snap, all of it still hurtling forward
the shut paper parcel sprints level with the python, a rat shaped bulge punching it from inside, legs pumping
his head fills the frame head on, billboards strobing past behind him, the paper parcel pumping along beside him
he throws himself into the lens one last time, jaws wide in the noon sun, then whips back onto the tarmac still driving hard

must_appear: at 1.0 he takes the mouse whole in one gulp on the run; he throws himself into the lens with jaws wide at 1.5, 2.2, 4.4 and 9.0; from 7.2 the paper is shut and a rat shaped bulge punches it from inside while the parcel runs beside him
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, letterbox, night, a cute cartoon snake, round friendly eyes, a thin small snake, a cobra hood, a human, a woman, walls of banknotes, a mouse after 1.5, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped snake, a paper maw worn on his head, a rat sitting inside open paper jaws, a shot from inside a throat, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, cyrillic letters, speech after 9.0
